name: crash-ai-obsidian
title: CrashAI Obsidian Writer MCP
description: Write CrashAI Markdown reports directly into Obsidian through the existing Argus Obsidian Bridge, with backend port fallback and a 300s timeout for large reports.
author: AIINWORK
capabilities: Test Argus Obsidian Bridge connection with backend port fallback
Write large CrashAI Markdown reports directly to Obsidian documents
Use stable argusId values to update the same report note
Preserve report metadata for later comparison

setupFields.label: Argus Base URL
setupFields.description: Local Argus/MTL-Code backend base URL that exposes /api/obsidian-bridge.

setupFields.label: Argus Probe URLs
setupFields.description: Comma-separated fallback Argus backend URLs when ARGUS_BASE_URL is unavailable.

setupFields.label: Argus Request Timeout MS
setupFields.description: Timeout for Obsidian write requests. Large CrashAI reports may need up to 300000 ms.

setupFields.label: Argus API Token
setupFields.description: Optional Argus API token if your backend requires Authorization.

setupFields.label: Obsidian Project Name
setupFields.description: Project folder/name used by Argus Obsidian Bridge.

setupFields.label: Obsidian Write Mode
setupFields.description: direct writes documents directly; wiki uses Argus wiki ingest; auto follows Argus backend default.

setupFields.label: Obsidian Vault ID
setupFields.description: Optional vault id when Argus has multiple Obsidian vaults.

setupFields.label: Obsidian Base Folder
setupFields.description: Optional write base folder inside the vault.

tools.name: obsidian_write_crash_report
tools.description: Write a CrashAI Markdown report into Obsidian.
